content.text: KAUN-O me sapwellimaniki sampah oh audepe kan koaros;
e ketin sapwellimaniki sampah oh mehkoaros me momour loale.
E ketin kauwada sampah pohnangin pihl akan,
oh ketin poahsoanehdahsang ni kepin madau kan.
Ihs me warohng kohdalahng pohn dohlen KAUN-O?
Ihs me pahn kak pedolong nan Tehnpese sarawio?
Irail kan me makelekel ni ar wiewia kan oh pil ni ar lamalam,
me sohte kin kaudokiong dikedik en eni kan,
oh me sohte kin wia inou likamw.
KAUN-O pahn ketin kupwuramwahwihirailda oh doareirailla;
Koht pahn ketin kalohkihda me sohte diparail.
Ih soangen aramas pwukat me kin patohdohng rehn Koht,
me kin patohdohng mwohn silangin Koht en Seikop.
Kumwail ritingada wenihmw kan,
kumwail langahda wenihmw laud akan,
pwe nanmwarki lapalapo en ketilong!
Ihs me nanmwarki lapalap menet?
lei ih me KAUN-O, me roson oh manaman,
KAUN-O, me kin powehdi nan mahwen.
Kumwail ritingada wenihmw kan,
kumwail langahda wenihmw laud akan,
pwe nanmwarki lapalapo en ketilong!
Ihs nanmwarki lapalap menet?
lei ih me KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie-iei ih me nanmwarki lapalapo!
